summary: Transformer Block cheat sheet (effort=max, ~853 lines, bilingual): third tutorial in this collection with a pre-draft cross-model design review (90 numbered claims). Overall-structure-ultra review initially returned '不建议原样定稿' — the proposed 'orthogonal design axes' framing had internal contradictions the draft itself exposed — driving a substantial restructure (5-layer hierarchical map, 3-family map, full modern-block forward walkthrough) rather than just point-fixes. Code review caught 7 real silent bugs (default non-causal mask, unchecked d_model divisibility, mask-broadcast collisions, KV-cache/start_pos inconsistency, unsafe cross-attention+RoPE+cache combination, NaN on fully-masked rows, RoPE cache device/dtype). Q&A review caught a genuine self-contradicting argument in the original Q23 draft. Final verdict: SHIP after full fix + re-verification.
